title: Français 4700 — Gondi symbol cipher, ff9r–10r
contents: Negotiations over the Pope’s absolution of the French king, with warnings that the Duke of Sessa was delaying a settlement; references to Savoy and Monsieur de Maisse.
status: 5/6 pages transcribed; 1 more in part; 3/6 pages deciphered
fields: 54 symbols: 42 letter signs, 4 doubled-letter signs, 8 in nomenclature
Historical Italian interlinear decipherments accompany the selected cipher lines on ff9r–10r / PDF21 and23.

excerpt: **luogo di queste parti doppa la reductione di parigi non abbiamo auto qui alcuna lettere di monsieur di reuol ne daltri ne fatta alcuna dimostratione di ralegramento con noi et si ua dubitando che si sia stato fatto qualche cattiuo uffitio da**
translation: … place in these parts. Since the submission of Paris, we have received no letters here from Monsieur de Revol or anyone else, nor any expression of congratulations; and there is suspicion that someone has done us a disservice …
